description: Deterministic quiz bank for Vani. Each item has a fixed canonical answer and a list of acceptable correct forms. Correctness is decided deterministically first; non-matching answers get one constrained LLM equivalence check. The LLM never generates questions or reference answers. Sentences are intentionally different from the lesson markdown examples.
